Ororo Waste funding of up to $1 million from Rising Tide Africa gives Nigeria’s used cooking oil sector fresh capital to build collection infrastructure and expand nationally.

##### **Capital targets Nigeria’s waste supply chain**
[Rising Tide Africa](https://risingtidesafrica.com/), a women-led pan-African angel investment network, committed up to $1 million — approximately ₦1.4 billion — to [Ororo Waste Management Limited](https://ororowaste.com/) via a corporate note.

web.description:
Ororo Waste Secures Up to $1 Million to Expand Used Cooking Oil Collection in Nigeria - Tech In Africa

[Follow us](https://www.techinafrica.com/ororo-waste-secures-up-to-1-million-to-expand-used-cooking-oil-collection-in-nigeria/#)

Nigerian waste-management company [Ororo Waste Management Limited](https://ororowaste.com/) has secured a commitment of up to $1 million from [Rising Tide Africa](https://risingtideafrica.com/?utm_) to expand its used cooking oil collection network across the country.

Ororo currently has about 5,000 formally paid collectors in its network.
